## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and what changes for a user or operator.

## Validation

List exact commands or CI links, results, and checks not run. Distinguish mocked, integration, local and hosted evidence.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe interface, configuration, migration and recovery effects, or state that there are none.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope and staged files reviewed; unrelated work excluded.
- [ ] Meaningful regression and documentation included where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, runtime databases or bulk raw evidence added.
- [ ] Security/domain invariants and negative controls preserved.
- [ ] Known failures and limitations remain explicit.
